procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: The user skips hand washing at start or finish, or fails to perform the inspection of the wound before applying the dressing.
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: All ordered steps A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, and A8 are observed to be performed sequentially.

observable_cues: visual confirmation of hand washing motion
limitations: System only provides 5-second interval snapshots, which are insufficient to verify entire procedural workflows or ensure no steps were skipped between samples.
Cannot guarantee continuity of actions across snapshots.
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_question: Were all actions completed in the correct order?

review_notes: The current system capabilities (periodic RGB snapshots) are insufficient to verify clinical actions like hand washing (A1, A8), glove removal (A7), or a continuous inspection (A4) due to lack of temporal resolution and action-aligned video.
The inspection criteria for the wound (A4) - specifically red, swollen, or leaking - are subjective clinical findings that a VLM cannot reliably diagnose from a single RGB image.
The instruction 'Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut' implies a spatial requirement (coverage) that may be ambiguous depending on the angle of the provided snapshot.
